title: Skin Care During Train Journey: AC Coach and Sleeper Class Guide
ex: A simple train skin kit and routine for AC coaches, sleeper class and long overnight journeys in India, plus what to do the night you arrive.
rt: Skin Care During Train Journey: Simple Kit | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care during a train journey in India: a small kit, a routine for AC coaches and sleeper class, sunscreen by the window and the night you arrive.
quick: On a train, keep your face clean with gentle wipes or rinses, moisturise before sleeping in dry AC air, wear sunscreen by the window and use lip balm. In dusty sleeper coaches, cover your face with a scarf and refresh with a thin layer of cream every few hours.
facts: AC coaches dry the skin overnight
Sun reaches your face through the window
Wipe or rinse gently when water is short
Put a clean cloth over the railway pillow
